title: Long Polling
definition: In Long Polling, the client makes a request, but the server intentionally holds the connection open until it actually has new data to send. Once sent, the client immediately opens a new long-polling connection.
simpleExplanation: Asking 'Are we there yet?' but the parents don't answer until 3 hours later when they finally arrive.

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of Long Polling?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
